$RXT is being given too much credit for a classic promo/hype playbook and the news last week sets it up for a deeper pullback. The timeline says it all:

· May: Q1 earnings + non-binding AMD MOU dropped. Stock +55%. Guidance? Reaffirmed. Not raised. read that again

· Mid June: Same AMD deal, now "definitive" announced alongside firing 15% of the workforce. Stock ramps. Market pays for the same news twice.

· Fine print: every MW of that 30MW deal needs a separate agreement, AMD has zero obligation

· July: guidance cut $150M. Q2 pre-announced as a miss. And $250M ATM via Goldman + a fresh shelf.

· The chaser: a shiny Palantir "definitive framework" stapled to the bad news, plus a claim of $15–20M revenue per MW at 50%+ margins. Someday. Starting 2027.

· Sequence: headline → reaffirm guide→ headline → layoffs → insiders sell along the way → shelf → ATM → Cut Guide. Every catalyst arrived exactly when the cap table needed it.

Investors are overpaying for a CFO with good calendar management.

$STKH Don't care how much you make on the back side of the China rigs. Trading them short on the front side of the moves is the worst possible choice one can make.

Yes there will be many that say "blah blah that's where I make most my $$" sure, but, yes, but at the expense of potential ruin one day. And, the ones that do it always come after that missed cover, that one last flush that you planned to cover but couldn't fill, or that one random account blow up that starts the domino effect.

How many do you need to see? $STAK last week and many others in the past.

"But this time is different" No! You never know which one is going to be the one they stick with and press.

Make your $ and graduate to bigger shit.

The longer you stay at that rigged casino, it's just a matter of time before you're the chosen one. It WILL catch up. You'll have your scare and if you're lucky enough to make it out w/o ruin have a real chat with yourself. It's not worth it.

Same recipe over and over. Lock shorts in day one, play coy for a few days squeeze them out on buy ins or just price alone.

The more China names you short front side, the more you have a degenerate gambling addiction, that's just the facts. Russian roulette or in this case Chinese shell game roulette.

Doesn't matter where it goes after the squeeze, you'd have to make it through a -90% draw down to make $. Use these examples you see every other day as a reminder that, it only takes one, to end your career.

Be safe out there, they're getting trickier and trickier - I get stressed just looking at the indications without even trading them.

And yes as I said there is money to be made -- but just know that upon trading it, you're taking that risk. Period. So if it happens to you, there's no complaining, you can't point figures, you can't blame, you knew the risk. As long as you're good with that, you do you. But, if/when - just make sure you own it.
